name: Emilia
source:
She is a Valkyrian but serves as Claudia's maid of honor. She is reserved and usually takes a back seat to Claudia.

She is interested in sexual intercourse, but her fear of it is still too great to allow her to experience it.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=755309]getchu[/url]]
